question: Select the synonym of **Taciturn.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Reserved**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Taciturn"** refers to someone who is habitually silent or reserved and tends to say very little. (मितभाषी)
 
 
• **Example:** Unlike his talkative brother, John was taciturn and preferred to observe quietly in group discussions.
 
 
 
• **"Reserved"** means someone who is quiet, restrained, or not very open in expressing their thoughts or feelings. (संकोची)
 
 
• **Example:** She is a reserved person who prefers to keep her opinions to herself in public settings.
 
 
 
• Hence, it is clear that **"Reserved"** is a synonym of **"Taciturn"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Reserved**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Bold** (साहसी): Someone who is confident and fearless in their actions or behavior.
 
 
• **Example:** The bold explorer ventured into the uncharted jungle without hesitation.
 
 
 
• **Talkative** (बातूनी): Someone who talks a lot, often excessively or without restraint.
 
 
• **Example:** The talkative child kept interrupting the teacher with questions and stories.
 
 
 
• **Noisy** (शोरगुल वाला): Something or someone making a lot of loud or disruptive sounds.
 
 
• **Example:** The noisy crowd made it difficult to hear the speaker during the event.
